name: jackson-dataformat-xml
reason: XmlMapper object/tree binding over a StAX XMLStreamReader (Woodstox by default); a data-binding layer with no XML tokenizer of its own. Highest metric, but it ranks a Jackson format module, not an XML parser.

name: jsoup
reason: HTML5 parser; Parser.xmlParser() is a lenient non-namespace-aware tree builder, so it does not meet the namespace-aware XML 1.0 scope. Not run.

name: xstream
reason: Object serialization library over pluggable XML drivers (XPP3, StAX, DOM); no XML tokenizer of its own. Not run.

name: woodstox-core
reason: Independent StAX parser (WstxInputFactory.createXMLStreamReader(InputStream)); highest true-parser lead after xercesImpl. Control not run in this pilot.

name: dom4j
reason: Legacy dom4j 1.x coordinate; SAXReader.read(InputStream) builds a tree over a JAXP SAX parser, which defaults to the JDK Xerces fork, so it has no tokenizer of its own. Even with org.dom4j:dom4j added (3,189) the parsing would re-measure the Xerces2-J family. Control not run.

name: dom4j
reason: dom4j 2.x; same SAXReader-over-JAXP design as dom4j:dom4j, defaulting to the JDK Xerces fork. Control not run.

name: xmlbeans
reason: Schema-bound XML binding; XmlObject.Factory.parse(InputStream) parses through its own Piccolo-derived/SAX layer. Control not run.

name: jdom2
reason: SAXBuilder.build(InputStream) builds a JDOM tree over a JAXP SAX parser (JDK Xerces fork by default); no tokenizer of its own. Control not run.

name: stax2-api
reason: StAX2 API interfaces only; implemented by Woodstox/Aalto. Not a parser.

name: jdom
reason: JDOM 1.x/2.0.2 coordinate; same SAXBuilder-over-JAXP design as jdom2. Control not run.

name: woodstox-core-asl
reason: Woodstox 4.x under the old Codehaus coordinate; same parser family as woodstox-core. Control not run.

name: aalto-xml
reason: Independent non-blocking StAX parser (AsyncXMLInputFactory / XMLInputFactory). Control not run.

name: FastInfoset
reason: Binary Fast Infoset (ITU-T X.891) codec, not a parser for textual XML 1.0.

name: xom
reason: nu.xom.Builder.build(InputStream) builds a tree over an XMLReader (Xerces when present, else JDK); no tokenizer of its own. Control not run.

name: xpp3
reason: XmlPullParser implementation (MXParser) with its own tokenizer; old 2006-era release line. Control not run.

name: kxml2
reason: XmlPullParser implementation (KXmlParser) with its own tokenizer, used on Android. Control not run.

name: vtd-xml
reason: VTDGen.setDoc(byte[]).parse(true) non-extractive token index; GPL-2.0. Control not run.
